Faithful OpenAPI representation of the publicly documented Buxfer REST API (https://www.buxfer.com/help/api). Buxfer is a personal finance and money management platform; this API lets a client read accounts, transactions, tags, budgets, reminders, groups, contacts and loans, and create/edit/delete transactions and upload statements. Authentication is a login call that returns an ephemeral token which must be passed as a `token` query parameter on every subsequent request. Responses use a JSON envelope with a `response` object whose `status` is either `OK` or `ERROR: <description>`.
